behaviours: a stage that completes its own work exits 0, not the stop code
header parser returns recorded driver and CUDA values and raises ValueError on truncated, blanked or error output
query parser returns recorded GPU name and driver and raises ValueError on missing-field, error or truncated output
elapsed-seconds parser returns the recorded value and raises ValueError on error or empty output
rank-table parser returns recorded rows, columns, mapping and top row
rank-table parser rejects truncated, field-missing, error, header-only, mixed-count and non-monotone tables with the required error text
PDB parser returns recorded atoms keyed by chain, residue, insertion code and atom name and raises ValueError on a truncated file
tool-log parser returns recorded per-model times and raises ValueError on missing-field, error and truncated logs
reporter parser returns recorded step and energy facts and raises ValueError on missing-field, truncated and error files
engine-rate parser never invents a value: the stated rate or an explicit null, ValueError or null on malformed copies
timing-rows parser returns run counts and means from the stage's own rows and rejects a truncated copy
stage exits 2 with a failed record, keeps the raw table and writes a diagnostic on an unparsable rank table
stage exits 2 with a failed record on a truncated pose, never a default value
stage exits 2 with a failed record on malformed or failing GPU queries
stage exits 2 with a failed record when a tool call errors
a tool log with a missing field yields no fabricated model time (failure or null with a reason)
stage exits 2 with a failed record on truncated rows input
a stage whose earlier-stage input is missing exits 2 naming the missing file
two runs of the repeated-call stage keep every call's outputs separate and each call reads its own output
multi-unit stage keeps each program call's outputs separate across runs and within one run
prediction calls each get their own results directory and their own row
worker calls per unit keep separate work directories and rows carry each call's own outputs
two fetch calls write separate paths and each run records its own download hash
capability probes read their own recorded outputs, calls inside a run stay distinct, two runs stay separate
guard refuses a stage below its allowance, calls no tool, and records the time arithmetic
guard starts a stage with ample allowance
budget guard stops at the dollar cap and records the arithmetic
reference scored against itself is perfect with a zero frame shift
reference against a rigidly transformed copy of itself is perfect
diagnostics are recorded with ok flags, perfect self and translated scores, and frame-guard rejection of a rotated copy
failing fixture gives the recorded FAIL verdict, invalid-run marking, and no withdrawn status
rotated pose is a frame-guard failure (exit 2, kind, diagnostic), never scored
every later record after a decision miss carries run_valid false and the voided-by text
calibration_valid on later records is decided by each record's own checks only and unchanged by the first decision
a per-record check failure stays that record's own (VOID with the raw value kept)
the first verdict and its record are unchanged by later stages
out-of-range system size and NaN energies fail only the record's own calibration check
control records exist with the required fields, machine labels and rows
a planted sleep that returns at once fails the control explicitly
lock record carries expected and observed hash and equality; mismatch and unset fail with exit 2
decision record carries measured, published, tolerance, diagnostics, frame and docking parameters with rank columns
endpoint records carry measured, unit, card value and band with decisions; summary compute table lists every stage
download record carries URLs and hashes; evidence files match their recorded hashes
rows files exist per arm with the fields and units the directive states
stages write only under --out
